acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of door sweep replacement in Meridian can vary based on several factors. These include the type and material of the new door sweep (e.g., standard vinyl vs. heavy-duty aluminum with brush seal), the complexity of the installation (some doors require minor adjustments or repairs to the door itself), and whether the service is part of a larger home improvement project. Our team provides transparent quotes, considering these details to offer a fair and accurate price for your specific needs.
